message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on the fact: 2013-2015, Xu used position as branch manager of bank, accepted cash 10,000 yuan from Zhang, in exchange for providing help in loan business. This is classic "受贿" (accepting bribes). Also possibly "行贿" is for the giver, not relevant. Could also be "滥用职权" but the fact is about receiving money for help, which is bribery. The amount is small but still bribery. So only "受贿". Provide format: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.
